_comment: Medium armor tag — non-metal armor (leather, scale, fur, wool, bone) + soft-metal vanilla (gold, chainmail). Untagged armor still defaults to MEDIUM at runtime, but these entries are explicit so future audits don't accidentally re-classify them. Per design 2026-05-03: vanilla iron = HEAVY (metal); gold/leather/chainmail = MEDIUM; modded non-metal (TF naga/yeti/arctic/phantom) = MEDIUM. See wiki/mods/custom.md iridescent_difficulty + kubejs/server_scripts/armor_weight.js.
